post.originalText:
I asked Opus 5.5 to explain BAAJA (the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act) by making an animated video.

Here's what it came up with after about an hour, with a little nudging. https://t.co/eKb8dTIU9X

sourceMaterials.text: Overall, I'm pretty happy with the result. There's a lot I could improve about the writing. Normally, I would manually write or co-author my transcripts for videos like this, but this was more of an automated process because I am working today.
